answers.core: This would be an enhancement to the UX of an already core part of the game, and one that would be in line with other selection methods inside the editor. This likely shouldn't be left as an add-on.
answers.workaround: It cannot be worked around through script, but it can be worked around with manual labor, by selecting each individual frame and moving/deleting it one by one. Not a great solution, but it does work. Technically.

title: Allow multi-selection of frames in the SpriteFrames animation editor
